name: target_legal
description: The legal target set of a side (-14 party side, -15 monsters) for a user and a command: Targetable, the target class and the only-by id, reach against BattleDistance, the dead flag.

function.signature: u32 legal_targets(int user, int selector, Cmd *cmd, int cmdId)

harness.note: the real machine code of the function in an x86-32 emulator; battle generator scripted (stream and value recorded); queue inserts and animation requests hooked

notes: in.sel is the selector code: -14 every party-side slot in battle and not removed, -15 every monster.
